---
title: "Grants"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
# Adapt these choices after reviewing the actual record schema/public fields.
record_file <- "data/grants.yml"
visible_fields <- c(title = "Title", sponsor = "Sponsor", role = "Role")
records <- yaml::read_yaml(record_file, eval.expr = FALSE)
if (is.null(records)) records <- list()
if (!is.list(records) || !is.null(names(records))) {
  stop("Expected a YAML sequence of records")
}
escape_html <- function(value) {
  value <- gsub("&", "&amp;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub("<", "&lt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub(">", "&gt;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value <- gsub('"', "&quot;", value, fixed = TRUE)
  value
}
display_value <- function(value) {
  if (is.null(value)) return("")
  if (!is.atomic(value) || length(value) != 1L) {
    stop("Visible fields must be scalar; adapt list/date fields explicitly")
  }
  if (is.na(value)) return("")
  escape_html(as.character(value))
}
if (length(records) == 0L) {
  cat("<p>No records to display.</p>\n")
} else {
  for (record in records) {
    if (!is.list(record) || is.null(names(record))) {
      stop("Each record must be a YAML mapping")
    }
    cat("<dl>\n")
    for (field in names(visible_fields)) {
      value <- display_value(record[[field]])
      if (nzchar(value)) {
        cat("<dt>", escape_html(visible_fields[[field]]), "</dt><dd>",
            value, "</dd>\n", sep = "")
      }
    }
    cat("</dl>\n")
  }
}
```
